title: OpenAI-compatible model gateway and provider adapters
invalid_containment: Malformed requests, auth failures, invalid JSON/SSE, provider status bodies, transport failures, and oversized or non-UTF8 payloads must fail without panics, hangs, secret leaks, route confusion, or misleading failure classification.
valid_correctness: All valid OpenAI-compatible JSON, SSE, tool-call, model-selector, retry, and provider error variants must normalize to the correct response or typed provider failure.
invalid_generators: arbitrary SSE bytes and malformed JSON chunks
route and auth selector near-misses, including sibling wildcard names
provider error/status envelope variants and transport failures
valid_generators: OpenAI-compatible JSON/SSE streams with legal frame splits and extra fields
model route, alias, provider, role, alloy, cascade, and dispatcher selector graphs
tool-call delta streams preserving choice indexes and argument fragments
oracles: malformed input never panics, hangs, leaks secrets, or routes to an unintended provider
valid streams preserve content, tool-call arguments, choice indexes, and typed provider failure classification
auth and route wildcards match only inside their explicit namespace

title: First-class and subprocess agent adapters
invalid_containment: Malformed callbacks, stale request IDs, wrong bearer tokens, bad attachment data, invalid JSON-RPC frames, hostile stdout/stderr, broken pipes, and hung children must not wake the wrong request or wedge adapter state.
valid_correctness: Valid callbacks, subprocess transcripts, ACP/ACPX frames, attachments, and OpenAI-compatible agent responses must correlate to the intended session and produce the correct normalized reply/artifact result.
invalid_generators: malformed, contradictory, duplicate, stale, and unauthenticated callbacks
partial JSON-RPC frames and hostile subprocess stdout/stderr
attachment payloads with missing metadata, unsupported media, huge bodies, and bad paths
valid_generators: correlated OpenClaw callback success and failure payloads across timing variants
valid ACP/ACPX and CLI transcripts with artifacts and text replies
OpenAI-compatible agent responses with legal content and tool-call shapes
oracles: invalid callbacks are acknowledged or rejected without waking the wrong request
valid replies correlate exactly once to the intended pending request
contradictory success and failure payloads become protocol errors

title: Inbound and outbound chat channel adapters
invalid_containment: Malformed updates, unknown senders, invalid HMACs, duplicate events, non-text payloads, missing reply targets, and provider rate-limit bodies must drop or degrade without auth bypass or command-state corruption.
valid_correctness: Valid channel payload variants must resolve the correct identity, route, reply target, command state, and outbound response semantics.
invalid_generators: malformed channel webhooks and provider update JSON
unknown or spoofed senders, duplicate events, invalid HMACs, missing reply targets
non-text attachments and rate-limit/error response bodies
valid_generators: valid Telegram, Matrix, Signal, WhatsApp, SMS, and mock channel message variants
group, direct-message, threaded, reply-target, and command-state event shapes
outbound response payloads across channel-supported formats
oracles: untrusted or unusable events drop without auth bypass or command-state mutation
valid events resolve the correct identity, routing target, reply target, and command state
duplicate or out-of-order events do not produce duplicate irreversible actions

title: Config, identity, auth, routing, and model selector inputs
invalid_containment: Malformed TOML, duplicate IDs, cyclic aliases, unsafe route globs, numeric overflows, unknown legacy fields, and invalid auth aliases must fail with typed errors and no partial unsafe config.
valid_correctness: Valid config graph variations must preserve the same authorization and routing decisions across identities, aliases, roles, shortcuts, alloys, cascades, dispatchers, and providers.
invalid_generators: malformed TOML/JSON, duplicate IDs, cyclic aliases, numeric overflows, and unknown legacy fields
unsafe wildcard and route selector near-misses
invalid identity aliases and auth allowlist combinations
valid_generators: identity, alias, routing, role, shortcut, provider, alloy, cascade, and dispatcher graphs
equivalent selector graphs that should produce the same authorization result
valid legacy and current config forms where compatibility is promised
oracles: invalid config fails with typed errors and no partial unsafe state
equivalent valid graphs preserve auth and routing decisions
wildcard semantics are namespace-bounded and consistent across auth and routing

title: Security proxy, adversary detector, and scanner policy
invalid_containment: Header smuggling, hostile response bodies, bad URL forms, malformed scanner payloads, broken Starlark/policy results, and invalid secret references must fail closed where security requires it.
valid_correctness: Valid proxied browser/provider traffic must substitute only authorized secrets, preserve allowed traffic, and keep blocked content out of model context.
invalid_generators: arbitrary bytes around secret references and placeholder tokens
hostile URLs, headers, scanner payloads, response bodies, and Starlark results
destination-policy lookalikes and malformed provider browsing tool definitions
valid_generators: valid secret-reference and placeholder documents with resolved values
allowed browser/provider traffic with authorized destination metadata
scanner verdict payloads and Starlark policy returns across supported forms
oracles: invalid security inputs fail closed where required and never leak secret material
valid substitutions render exactly once using authorized values only
blocked destinations and blocked content never reach model context

title: Fnox, MCP, paste, metadata, and secret-reference inputs
invalid_containment: Missing, hung, or non-UTF8 fnox output, malformed MCP params, replayed paste tokens, invalid origins, and malformed .env or metadata must not leak or misapply secrets.
valid_correctness: Valid secret refs, metadata, MCP calls, paste submissions, and .env entries must resolve to the correct vault operation and destination policy.
invalid_generators: malformed secret names, metadata destination strings, MCP params, paste tokens, and fnox output
non-UTF8, empty, hung, or partial process outputs
invalid Origin/Referer and replayed or expired paste submissions
valid_generators: valid secret refs, destination metadata, MCP calls, paste submissions, and .env entries
fnox list/get/set output variants the wrapper claims to support
destination allowlist forms with normalization and deduplication
oracles: invalid secret inputs never leak or misapply values
valid secret references resolve to the intended vault operation and destination policy
destination normalization is lowercase, deduplicated, URL-free, and stable

title: Filesystem, persistence, installer, doctor, services, hooks, and local model lifecycle
invalid_containment: Symlinks, permission failures, missing dirs, corrupt SQLite/config, SSH partial failures, stale service files, hook hangs, and concurrent model switches must not corrupt owned state or pretend live paths are healthy.
valid_correctness: Valid source, Homebrew, Docker, user, and system layouts must make doctor, runtime, service managers, hooks, local model state, and persistence agree on the same files and paths.
invalid_generators: filesystem tempdir chaos with symlinks, permission errors, missing dirs, corrupt files, and partial writes
mock SSH/service/process failures and hook hangs
concurrent model switch and stale service layout sequences
valid_generators: source, Homebrew, Docker, user, and system install layouts
valid service templates, hook envs, config paths, and local model lifecycle states
doctor/runtime path combinations that should agree
oracles: invalid filesystem inputs do not corrupt state outside owned paths
doctor checks the same path the runtime and install actions use
valid layouts make doctor, runtime, services, hooks, persistence, and local model state agree

title: Host-agent RPC, approval, and host operation adapters
invalid_containment: mTLS identity mismatch, malformed RPC JSON, replayed approvals, spoofed webhooks, bad dataset names, path metacharacters, and rate-limit edge cases must not mutate host resources.
valid_correctness: Valid approved operation sequences must mutate only intended resources and preserve audit, identity, adapter, and rate-limit semantics.
invalid_generators: malformed RPC JSON, mTLS identity mismatch, replayed approvals, spoofed webhooks, and rate-limit edge cases
bad dataset names, path metacharacters, invalid systemd/unit identifiers, and git/pct/zfs operation variants
operation sequences with missing approval, stale approval, or conflicting identity
valid_generators: approved operation sequences for exec, git, pct, systemd, and zfs adapters
valid identity, approval token, audit, and rate-limit state transitions
mock host resources with bounded mutations
oracles: invalid host-agent inputs never mutate host resources
approved valid operations mutate only intended resources
audit, identity, adapter, and rate-limit semantics remain consistent across operation sequences

title: Clashd policy hooks and remote domain lists
invalid_containment: Malformed hooks, huge or redirecting domain lists, punycode/wildcard edge cases, and invalid policy results must fail safely.
valid_correctness: Valid hook payloads, domain-list formats, and policy returns must produce deterministic routing and allow/deny decisions.
invalid_generators: arbitrary remote domain-list bytes, invalid regex patterns, huge lists, redirects, and malformed hooks
punycode, wildcard, IP, hosts-file, URL, and comment edge cases
invalid Starlark policy results and timeout-like policy behavior
valid_generators: valid exact, regex, hosts-file, and URL domain-list formats
valid hook payloads and policy return variants
domain probes covering exact, subdomain, case-insensitive, and non-match paths
oracles: malformed policy/domain inputs fail safely without unsafe allow decisions
valid domain lists produce deterministic match decisions
valid policy returns map to the intended allow, deny, or review decision
